name: v3-understeer-affine
description: Per-platform understeer-aware affine correction of the V0 KS yaw-rate prediction: yaw = (k*v0)/(1 + K_us*v^2) + b. Coefficients fit by least squares per platform on data/sim/segments/.
trajectory_integration: deferred-to-grader (x_m, y_m omitted; grader integrates from yaw_rate + v_mps)
